meta.title: Proposal Allocation Summary after awarding line-wise: line 1 to B, line 2 to A
gaps: Verify line 1 is awarded to vendor B and line 2 to vendor A because the prepared event has only one line item and one vendor.
Verify vendor B totals 900 and vendor A totals 250, with a combined total of 1,150.
Compare the Allocation Summary with a downloaded report and purchase orders.

plan.title: Proposal Allocation Summary after line-wise award

steps.note: Open the existing awarded event's proposal page as the buyer.
Open the proposal's Allocation Summary panel.
Assert that the Allocation Summary is displayed.
Assert that the summary shows the selected-item total label.
Assert that the summary shows the total-amount label.
Assert that the Allocation Summary contains at least one vendor allocation row in the available prepared state.
